title: The Days That Vanished: Why Calendars Skipped Days (1582, 1752 and Sweden's 30 February)
description:
Why did calendars skip days? In 1752 Britain went from the 2nd of September straight to the 14th. Sweden had a 30th of February. Russia lost thirteen days in 1918. This is the story of the Julian calendar's small error, the Gregorian fix of 1582, and how each country threw days away at its own time.
